privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: {operator} manages aircraft for their owners. This portal gives owners access to their flights, hours, finances and invoices. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why, where it is kept and how to exercise your rights, under Québec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector.
privacyPolicy.officerTitle: Person in charge of protecting personal information
privacyPolicy.officerMissing: Our privacy officer's contact details will be published here before the portal opens.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Your identity and contact details: name, email, phone, language.
Your aircraft share: percentage, allotted hours, flights taken and their routes.
Your aircraft-related finances: budgets, costs, payments and invoices.
Your messages with our team and the files you attach.
Security data: IP address and browser when you sign in, and a log of actions taken in the portal.

sections.title: Why
items: To manage your aircraft share, schedule your flights and keep your accounts.
To invoice you and send you budgets, statements and notices.
To protect your account: two-step verification for our team, attempt limits, an audit log.
To meet our legal and tax obligations.
We don't use your information for advertising and we don't sell it.

sections.title: Where it is kept
items: The database and files (invoices, attachments) are hosted in Canada, in Amazon Web Services' Montreal region, encrypted at rest.
The portal itself is served by Vercel; pages are built on servers in the United States, which process your information while showing a page without keeping it.
Emails (notices, sign-in links) are sent by Resend, in the United States, which receives your email address and the message content.
Before communicating information outside Québec, we assess the privacy factors and bind these providers by contract.

sections.title: Who can see it
items: You, and the other people authorized on your owner account.
Our team, according to their role (dispatch, finance, administration). Every “view as owner” session and every change is logged.
Co-owners of the same aircraft never see your flights or finances: only that the aircraft is booked.

sections.title: How long
items: Financial records (entries, invoices, budgets) are kept at least six years after the end of the tax year, as tax law requires.
Expired sessions and sign-in links are deleted automatically; unused invitations after 90 days; read notices after a year.
When our relationship ends, other information is deleted or anonymized once legal periods have passed.

sections.title: Your rights
items: Access your information and get a copy in a structured format: download it any time from My account.
Have inaccurate information corrected.
Ask us to delete information that is no longer needed, subject to our legal obligations.
Withdraw consent to optional emails from My account.
File a complaint with Québec's Commission d'accès à l'information.
We answer every request within 30 days.

sections.title: Confidentiality incidents
items: We keep a register of confidentiality incidents. If an incident presents a risk of serious injury, we notify the Commission d'accès à l'information and the people concerned promptly.
